deploy-bot: Starting staging deploy for service=inference-runtime env=staging tag=release-2026-03-14 commit=5a3f1c2
CI: all pipelines passed: unit, integration, perf. Build: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/12345

mira: noted, pinning model artifact to model:v2.3-quant to avoid flakiness during perf tests.

sam: thanks — any manual checks we should run while canary ramps?

qa-bot: running automated smoke suite (smoke/runtime-smoke) — started.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated: 10% traffic -> new pods. Command (for reference): `kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-runtime -n staging`

miguel: seeing a transient 503 against the canary after 2 POSTs to /v1/chat/completions, collecting logs now.

mira: miguel ping me if it's related to KV-cache warmup — we've seen a short spike before, might be expected but worth validating.

qa-bot: smoke suite finished: 28/28 checks passed. latency metrics: p50=85ms, p95=210ms, no error traces.

sam: did a quick manual sanity with the web demo and a long-context prompt — responses look correct, no tokenization regressions. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout progressed: 50% -> 100%. Rollout complete: staging deploy finished in 6m39s. tag=release-2026-03-14 commit=5a3f1c2
Release notes (brief): swapped attention kernel to fused-attn-v2, batching scheduler tweak to prefer short-seq packing. Impact: lower p50 overall, small p95 variability during cold starts.
Change window: standard staging window, no extended downtime.

dena: leaving a note — please hold any prod rollouts until we finish the extended perf eval on the large prompt set tomorrow (runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INF-PerfEval). @sam @mira

mira: ack — scheduling the eval and will post results here once complete. :eyes:
